meta.name: ai-social-media-content
meta.description: Create AI-powered social media content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter/X. Generate: images, videos, reels, shorts, thumbnails, captions, hashtags. Tools: FLUX, Veo, Seedance, Wan, Kokoro TTS, Claude for copywriting. Use for: content creators, social media managers, influencers, brands. Triggers: social media content, tiktok, instagram reels, youtube shorts, twitter post, content creator, ai influencer, social content, reels, shorts, viral content, thumbnail generator, caption generator, hashtag generator, ugc content

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成社交媒体图文视频内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量制作社交媒体帖子、视频和文案。
copy.tagline_en: Create social media images, videos, and captions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce social media posts, videos, and copy at scale.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的指令生成社交媒体内容，包括图片、视频、缩略图、文案和话题标签，并支持 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Twitter/X 等平台。
howto.when: 当你要求制作社交媒体内容，或提到“TikTok”、“Instagram Reels”、“YouTube Shorts”等平台或“内容创作”、“AI 网红”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个 TikTok 风格的短视频，主题是东京夜景。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Veo 模型生成 9:16 竖屏视频。

say.text: 制作一个 YouTube 缩略图，要求有震惊表情和亮黄色背景。
say.note: Claude 会调用 FLUX 模型生成缩略图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate social media content including images, videos, thumbnails, captions, and hashtags for platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitter/X based on your instructions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create social media content or mention platforms like "TikTok", "Instagram Reels", "YouTube Shorts", or keywords such as "content creator", "AI influencer".

say_en.text: Generate a TikTok-style video about Tokyo night streets.
say_en.note: Claude will use Veo model to create a 9:16 vertical video.

say_en.text: Write an engaging Instagram caption with 10 hashtags for a sunset photo.
say_en.note: Claude will use Claude Haiku to generate caption and hashtags.

say_en.text: Create a YouTube thumbnail with a shocked face and bright yellow background.
say_en.note: Claude will use FLUX model to generate the thumbnail.
